io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.longDescription: StemConsole is an AI stem splitter and vocal remover. Connect a StemConsole account (OAuth at /mcp/account, or an API key at /mcp) to split 1 to 10 songs from public audio links on the account's own plan: Vocal Remover (vocals, instrumental), the free 4-stem Basic Split (vocals, drums, bass, other), or Full Separation with guitar and piano (Pro or a US$1.99 credit). Each split returns MP3 stem links and a link to practise the song in StemConsole's practice room, with WAV links and a ZIP of all stems on Pro. The account tools also show the plan and splits left, list, rename and delete songs, and list and create setlists. Without an account, get_capabilities explains the plans and get_task_url returns the right StemConsole tool page. Free accounts get 5 splits a month.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.pricing: Free: 5 splits a month. Pro: US$6.99 a month or US$49 a year. Single-song credit: US$1.99.
